name: RBAZ Bancorp, Inc.
summary: RBAZ Bancorp, Inc. operates as the parent company for Republic Bank of Arizona, delivering a comprehensive suite of community banking products and services. Based in Phoenix, Arizona, and founded in 2007, the company caters to individuals, businesses, and professionals across the state. Its offerings include various checking and savings accounts for both personal and commercial clients. For businesses, RBAZ Bancorp provides diverse financing options such as term loans, equipment financing, commercial real estate mortgages, and Small Business Administration (SBA) loans, in addition to accounts receivable financing and flexible lines of credit. The bank also issues debit, credit, and ATM cards, and offers specialized services like treasury management, remote deposit capture, merchant card processing, and programs tailored for non-profit organizations. Customers can also access convenient digital banking through online and mobile platforms, alongside essential services like ATMs, courier support, notary services, wire transfers, official checks, and secure night depository options.
